BILL NUMBER:  S1070

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend chapter 507 of the laws of 1974, relating to providing
for the apportionment of state monies for nonpublic schools, in
relation to providing for an additional apportionment for asbestos
inspections


 SUMMARY :
This bill would amend chapter 507 of the laws of 1974 to provide that
non-public schools are reimbursed for administrative costs incurred
which relate to federally mandated asbestos inspections as required by
the Asbestos Hazard Emergency Act of 1986 (AHERA). This bill would add
asbestos inspections to the provisions of the Mandated Services Act
which already includes the administrative costs associated with
attendance reports, PEP test reports, Regents Competency and
Examination Programs.

 JUSTIFICATION :
All schools, public and non-public are under strict federal mandates
to inspect for asbestos and to eliminate any conditions hazardous to
health. While Chapter 262 of the Laws of 1988 provides $4 million for
inspections, non-public schools are not reimbursed for the expenses
incurred in completing the necessary reports and other paperwork
associated with the mandates. This bill would allow for state
reimbursement to these costs under the same section of law that
provides for the costs of complying with other mandates such as
attendance reports, data system reports and several reports associated
with student examinations.

 FISCAL IMPLICATION :
This bill is estimated, to have a cost of approximately $400,000.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Provides for an additional apportionment of state monies to nonpublic schools for the cost of asbestos inspections for school years beginning on and after July 1, 2009.
title: Provides for apportionment of state monies to nonpublic schools for the cost of asbestos inspections
